input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: sample_object_dn
input.label: Sample entry DN
input.hint: Used to introspect the attributes in the object. Provide a distinguished name of an existing entry, e.g. CN=Jake Smith,ou=People.

input.name: since
input.label: When first started, this recipe should pick up events from
input.hint: Get entry created since the given date/time. Leave empty to get entries created 1 hour ago. Once recipe has been run or tested, value cannot be changed. Learn more

input.name: limit
input.label: Limit
input.hint: Number of results being returned. Maximum value is 1000.

triggers.name: paged_search_entries
triggers.title: Scheduled entry search using search filter
triggers.description: Scheduled entry search using search filter in Active Directory
triggers.help: Executes search based on filter on specified schedule and returns results as list of entries.

input.name: sample_object_dn
input.label: Sample entry DN
input.hint: Used to introspect the attributes in your entry object. Give a distinguished name for a known entry, E.g: CN=Jake Smith,ou=People . Do not use formula or pills.

input.name: search_filter
input.label: Entry search filter
input.hint: Active Directory filter to search the entries. E.g: &(ou=Dev)(objectClass=Person) .

input.name: batch_size
input.label: Batch size
input.hint: Number of Active Directory entries to process in each batch. Larger batch size will increase recipe speed & data throughput. Sometimes Workato will automatically reduce your batch size to avoid hittin…

input.name: limit
input.label: Limit
input.hint: Number of results being returned. Maximum value is 1000.

actions.name: search_entries
actions.title: Search entries
actions.help: Search will return entries that match all your search criteria. A maximum of 1000 records will be fetched.

input.name: sample_object_dn
input.label: Sample entry DN
input.hint: Used to introspect the attributes in the object. Provide a distinguished name of an existing entry, e.g. CN=Jake Smith,ou=People

input.name: limit
input.label: Limit
input.hint: Number of results being returned. Maximum value is 1000.

input.name: page_size
input.label: Batch size
input.hint: Number of entries per single batch. If the value is greater than or equal to the limit, the action returns just one batch. The value of 0 signals to the server that the iteration is over.

input.name: page_cookie
input.label: Batch cookie
input.hint: The cookie value is used to fetch the next batch. Pass the cookie value returned by the same action earlier, or an empty value to retrieve the first batch.

output.name: page_cookie
output.label: Batch cookie
output.hint: Pass this value as input to this action in the loop to get the next batch.
